maintenance_led.reason: Mainly sells new rail products, friction management, precast concrete and steel piling for projects, not mainly repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Main customers are freight railroads, transit operators and private contractors; public-agency projects are only part of sales.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own rail and infrastructure product sales, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Safety-critical rail friction management, monitoring and passenger information systems are specified and approved into railroad networks, so switching is costly.

notes: Revenue split and customer mix are judged from general knowledge; the website text gives no segment breakdown.
